BiblicalUsage: Sephar is the Aramaic word for a book, and it turns up where records decide things. Enemies of the Jews asked that search be made in the book of the records, Darius ordered a search in the house of the rolls, and the priests were set in their courses as it is written in the book of Moses. In Daniel's vision the books were opened before the throne, and judgment began.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe books matter to God because the truth is written down, not left to rumour. What is recorded can be searched, and what is searched will one day be opened.
